# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 26 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** The Book's Conclusion — An Invitation to the Reader

---

**1** This is the book of Aseneth's conversion and her life with Joseph.

**2** All who read it and take it to heart will be blessed, for it sets out the way of those who turn to the living God.

**3** It is written to instruct all who wish to turn from idols to the worship of the Most High God.

**4** May those who read give thanks to God — the giver of all good gifts — and to his servant Joseph, through whom the nations were fed.

**5** And let them give thanks for Aseneth, who was lifted up from among the nations and counted among God's chosen people.

**6** Glory to God, who does such wonders for those who love him and take refuge in him.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
